Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment:

- Trial timeline: start trial ASAP (you mentioned week of Feb 23), target trial end Mar 8.
- Commercial path options: 1) Standard self-serve with corporate card and pay-as-you-go; 2) PO-based purchase with monthly invoicing (requires Acme PO + net30); 3) AWS Marketplace listing (if you prefer procurement via marketplace subscription).
- Docs I attached: trial quote (redwood-trial-quote.pdf) and a short terms summary (redwood-terms-summary.pdf).

1) Which commercial path do you prefer (card vs PO vs marketplace)?
2) Who owns the PO process on your side and are there standard terms we should be aware of? (If PO: sample PO template and billing contact would be helpful.)
3) For trial-to-paid conversion: what usage threshold or success signal should we use to auto-propose a billing start date? We suggested a billing start the day after trial end unless you want a manual sign-off.

I can loop in our finance/ops if you prefer a PO template or an SOW. Ben (cc'd) can help with pricing if you want to tweak the quote. Dev (cc'd) will support the onboarding and monitoring.

Rajiv / procurement team — thanks. Answers below and next steps: 

1) Legal entity and address for PO: 
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Address: 1201 Market St, Suite 1400, San Francisco, CA 94103

2) MSA vs terms summary: For trials we accept a short terms summary + quote in lieu of a signed MSA. If your legal team requires an MSA we can execute via DocuSign; otherwise attaching your PO to the quote is fine.

3) Billing start / trial-to-paid conversion: We are flexible. Two common paths we support: 
- Auto-bill: billing starts the day after the trial end date unless you notify us to hold billing.
- Manual conversion: you sign off on acceptance and we create the invoice with your PO start date.

Given your preference for PO + monthly invoicing, we recommend the manual conversion route so you control the billing start date. Typical flow we use: you issue PO referencing our quote (attached), we accept PO + SOW (if needed), we schedule final acceptance review on trial end, then start billing on agreed date (often next billing cycle).

4) Marketplace: if you want to purchase via AWS Marketplace, procurement will still need an internal procurement SKU and we can provide marketplace pricing. Marketplace purchases usually have a slightly longer setup time (2-3 business days) but are often easier for centralized procurement teams.

Attachments: I re-attached redwood-trial-quote.pdf and redwood-terms-summary.pdf. Ben, can you confirm pricing if they want to convert to an annual committed plan after trial?

Next step: procurement sync Tue Feb 24 10:00am PT — here's the calendar invite I sent. If procurement prefers a different time, suggest alternatives.

Thanks,
